title: Numerical Approximation of the stochastic Cahn--Hilliard equation with singular potential
summary: We discuss the numerical approximation of the stochastic Cahn--Hilliard equation with a singular double-obstacle potential and multiplicative conservative noise. We propose a regularised fully discrete finite element approximation scheme for the problem and show that it satisfies stability estimates which are uniform with respect to the discretization parameters. We show convergence of the approximation for vanishing discretization parameters towards a regularised version of the singular stochastic Cahn--Hilliard equation by monotonicity arguments.
